style: Warm, whimsical children's picture-book illustration. Soft painterly digital art with visible brushwork, gentle sunlit lighting, a cozy and inviting color palette. Friendly, rounded character design. Single clear scene, no text or watermarks, no panel borders.
characters: Mia: a girl about 8 years old with brown hair in two pigtails, wearing a pink t-shirt and denim shorts. Tom: a boy about 8 years old with short brown hair, wearing a blue t-shirt and green shorts. A small friendly tan dog appears later.
cover: Mia and Tom playing together in a sunny park with a red ball, big trees, a wooden fence in the background, joyful summer afternoon light.
pages: Mia and Tom skipping happily hand in hand into a sunny green park, tall trees and blue sky, big smiles, golden morning light.
Tom kicking a red ball hard under a big tree, the ball flying toward a wooden fence, Mia watching in surprise.
Mia climbing carefully over a low wooden fence to reach the red ball resting beside bright yellow flowers.
Mia and Tom sitting together on a park bench, eating sandwiches and drinking juice from a small picnic, sunny and relaxed.
A small friendly tan dog approaching Mia and Tom at the park bench, Mia gently offering it a small piece of sandwich.
Mia and Tom lying on the grass looking up at fluffy clouds in the sky at sunset, a peaceful and happy end to the day.
